notes: NativePlaylist::GetPlaylistElement(): the group walk with the reset-flag branch; group positions and Reset(1) calls as in the ARM listing (r1 = 1 before each reset). Returns the element pointer. Guard: no groups returns nullptr where the original reads group 0.
NativePlaylist::PeekAtNextElement(): read-only walk; peek modes 0 and 1 as in the original. Returns the element pointer.
NativePlaylist::Reset(): saves indices and repeats, restarts at group 0, calls Reset(1) on each group.

NativePlaylist::SetState(NativePlaylist&): copies the nine scalar words, then the base SegmentGroup::SetState on each group (slot +0x14). The original's GetSelectMode call has no effect and is left out.
NativePlaylist::SetToPreviousState(): calls SetToPreviousState on the previous group (slot +0x18), then restores group, element and repeats.
NativePlaylistsManager::GetPlaylistElement(index, mode, argument): modes 0, 1 and 2 forward to the playlist; other modes return nullptr. Return type is PlaylistElement*.
NativePlaylistsManager::PeekAtNextPlaylistElement(index): returns the playlist's PeekAtNextElement (PlaylistElement*).
NativePlaylistsManager::ResetPlaylist(index): negative index does nothing; otherwise Reset the playlist.
NativePlaylistsManager::SetPlaylistToPreviousState(index): forwards to the playlist.
NativePlaylistsManager::SetState(manager): copies the flag and field_04, then NativePlaylist::SetState on each playlist.
NativePlaylist D1: destroys and frees each group (virtual destructor, VoxFree), then frees each PlaylistElement block.
NativePlaylistsManager D1: destroys and frees each playlist, then the pointer array.
NativePlaylistsManager D2: same body as D1.
NativePlaylist D2: same body as D1.

NativePlaylist::SetState(PlaylistState*): copies the six words, then copies each group's state. The record type follows the source group's select mode (SequentialGroup::State or RandomGroupState), as the original's slot +0x1c and +0x24 calls do. A short state vector throws out_of_range as the original does.
NativePlaylistsManager::TransposePlaylistParameters(from, to): GetState from one playlist into SetState of the other; nothing when the indices match.

NativePlaylist::AddPlaylistElement: builds the PlaylistElement (words 3 to 6), appends it to the PlaylistElement* vector, then adds to the group: a RandomGroupElement copy (value word 1, weight word 7) for select mode nonzero, else the sequential value word 1. A failed allocation clears valid.
NativePlaylistsManager::AddPlaylistElement: forwards to the playlist at words_[0] and takes its validity.
NativePlaylist::AddGroup: RandomGroup (0x5c in the original) for select mode nonzero, SequentialGroup (0x38) otherwise, built with the playlist reset flag and appended.
NativePlaylistsManager::AddGroup: forwards to the playlist at unknown_00_ and takes its validity.

NativePlaylist C1 copy: scalar words, then group copies by select mode (copy constructors), then element copies into new blocks. A rejected group copy is freed by the port (the original leaves it allocated).
NativePlaylistsManager C1 copy: flag and field_04, then one NativePlaylist copy per source playlist.
NativePlaylistsManager C2 copy: same body as C1.
NativePlaylist C2 copy: same body as C1.
